messages:
Maya: Morning team — quick triage: overnight volume spiked ~35% (mostly webhook/ingest errors). Two P1s opened: one websocket reconnect loop, one high-rate retry causing duplicate events. ETA for fixes: unknown. Who can pick up the duplicate-events investigation?

Leo: I can start on the duplicate-events. Seen similar issue last month with backoff misconfig in the proxy. Will triage now and post findings.

Anika: I'll take the websocket reconnect loop after I finish the billing followup (30–45m). Can you drop the sample logs in thread, Leo?

Maya: @Leo sample attached in case it's helpful: 
```
2026-03-17T05:12:03Z ERROR webhook-handler Duplicate event received id=evt_01G... retries=4 source=queue-3
2026-03-17T05:12:03Z WARN  proxy backoff=0ms forwarded=true
```
Seems like retries are immediate (backoff=0ms).

Leo: Yup that's telling. Patch idea: default backoff not applied if 'x-forwarded-internal' header present. I'll check proxy middleware. Also pinging KJ for a config quick change if we need to flip to safe defaults.

KJ: on it. If Leo confirms patch, I can roll a runtime flag to enable exponential backoff for the affected pool (canary to 10% first). Need the exact pool id to scope.

Anika: For the websocket P1, I saw a client-side reconnect storm in the trace. Could be a client-side regression after last SDK release. Reached out to internal CS contact to ask for a sample client stack.

Maya: Flags: 
- Volume: +35% overnight, ~480 new tickets (baseline 360)
- P1s: websocket-reconnect, duplicate-webhook
- Known issue: embeddings ingest delay in eu-west started at 03:40 UTC, appears to be TTL contention on the router. Eng-infra looped in already.
- Macros to use: 
  • "dup-webhook-investigation": 
    "Hi — thanks for the report. We're investigating duplicate delivery semantics. Can you confirm if your client implements exponential backoff and include X-Request-Id headers?"
  • "websocket-reconnect-guide": 
    "Quick checklist: update SDK >= 1.4.2, ensure jitter on reconnects, and disable aggressive auto-retry on network error 1006. See internal doc: https://redwood/internal/ws-reconnect"

Leo: Using macro dup-webhook-investigation on a few tickets now. Noting one vendor integration where header insertion is stripped by their CDN — could be a cause.

SupportBot: Automations: flagged 23 tickets with tag:webhook-dup as high priority. Created search: "is:open tag:webhook-dup after:2026-03-16"

KJ: Dropping the canary flag to enable backoff on pool 'ingest-prod-3'. Rolling out in 5m, monitor latency/error-rate. If anything spikes, I'll revert.

Anika: Update on websocket P1 — client stack sample incoming from CS. If it's client-side, we can mitigate with a temporary rate-limit by IP at edge to reduce reconnect storms. Will propose in 20m.

Maya: OK — action items: 
- Leo: root cause triage for duplicate events + patch if needed (follow up in thread)
- KJ: canary backoff toggle on ingest-prod-3 (monitor 10–30m)
- Anika: websocket P1 client confirmation + mitigation proposal
- Support: apply macros dup-webhook-investigation and websocket-reconnect-guide to affected tickets (prioritize P1s)

Any blockers for those? If not, let's re-sync in 30m with short updates here. :thumbsup:
